$comment: Every difference between expected.json and the engines' read-back (test/real-world-truth/engine/*.json), with its resolution. Checked by test/unit/realWorldEngineTruth.test.ts; docs/dev/real-world-truth.md says how to rerun.

differences: what still differs, item by item (resolution engine-limit: the engine, not the truth, is short). resolved: what differed before this file and was fixed (truth from the engine, the importer where it was wrong); none may differ again. equivalences: one thing spelled two ways. modellingChoices: deliberate readings the truth keeps (handled by the comparison or outside the truth's scope). loadErrors: every statement an engine refused, by pattern and count.

resolved.engine: payment_date, payment_id on each of the 55 partitions
resolved.reason: The dump writes the primary key only on payment (inline in its CREATE TABLE) and joins each partition with ALTER TABLE ONLY payment ATTACH PARTITION; PostgreSQL creates the parent's primary key on every partition it attaches. Truth: 55 more primary keys (counts.primaryKeys 16 -> 71, floor raised). Importer: a partition kept as a table now gets its parent's primary key, unique keys and foreign keys (sqlDdlPartitions.ts inheritPartitionKeys; not for ON ONLY / ALTER TABLE ONLY keys or INHERITS children; tests in sqlDdlPartitions.test.ts).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_uuid_key ON public.payment (not ON ONLY) builds the index on every partition. Truth: 55 more unique keys (floor 5 -> 60). Importer: as above.

Each is a computed column ISNULL(expr, <constant>), which SQL Server makes non-nullable (its documented way to a NOT NULL computed column). Truth: N flag added. Importer: sqlDdlColumns.ts isNullWithConstant reads ISNULL(expr, number) and ISNULL(string expr, string) as NOT NULL; other expressions stay nullable (checked case by case on SQL Server 2025, sqlDdlFidelity.test.ts).

AUTOINCREMENT is the column's identity property, not part of its type (information_schema data_type NUMBER, precision 38, scale 0). The importer already kept the type and the increment; types verbatim 229 -> 237.

equivalences.importer: Name, Flag, … kept by name (ledger: based on nvarchar(50) …)
equivalences.reason: An unqualified alias type is the dbo one: the same type, spelled with its schema (canonType strips dbo.).

equivalences.importer: not kept, reported: "expression unique index" lost at 0190_2.16.0_schema.up.sql:45
equivalences.reason: PostgreSQL adds the ::text cast when it stores the expression; the same key. An expression is not a column key, so the scorecard does not count it.

equivalences.truth: as written (SERIAL, varchar (30), INT(11), [nvarchar](60), NUMBER(12), STRING, BIGINT …)
equivalences.engine: canonical (integer, character varying(30), int, nvarchar(60), NUMBER(12,0), string, long …)
equivalences.reason: One type spelled two ways: canonType (test/unit/realWorldEngineTruth.ts) brings each dialect's aliases to one form before comparing; anything else that differs is a difference.

modellingChoices.engine: 71 tables (55 with relispartition, attached to payment)
modellingChoices.truth: 16 tables: partitions folded into payment, their 18 FKs as 3 from payment
modellingChoices.reason: Partition folding (the default import): a partition is payment's rows, not a table. The comparison folds the engine's partitions the same way (foldPartitions) and then finds no difference; postgres-pagila-partitions-kept holds the 71-table reading.

modellingChoices.engine: FK columns NOT NULL as declared
modellingChoices.importer: every relationship saved optional (?), with the one D18 sentence counting the required ones
modellingChoices.reason: D18 stays: ERD Studio saves every Ref optional and says how many were required; the truth keeps the engine nullability, so the scorecard measures the note.

modellingChoices.engine: golang-migrate's own table (created by the tool before 0001; 0030 and 0040 alter it)
modellingChoices.importer: not drawn; its two ALTERs are said as not applied
modellingChoices.reason: The tool's bookkeeping table, never created by the files: the read-back creates it as golang-migrate does and leaves it out (hidden).

modellingChoices.item: UNSTRUCTURED.DOCUMENT_SEARCH_INDEX (CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE … AS SELECT, line 271)
modellingChoices.engine: Snowflake makes a 9-column table; fakesnow fails (DuckDB lambda binder), so it is not read back
modellingChoices.importer: skipped: 'CREATE TABLE without a column list (AS SELECT, LIKE, CLONE)' at 03_unstructured_data_schema.sql:271
modellingChoices.reason: A CTAS has no declared columns to model; SOURCE.md excludes it.

modellingChoices.item: ALTER TABLE … SET TAGS (58) / ALTER COLUMN … SET MASK (16)
modellingChoices.engine: Unity Catalog statements open-source Spark's parser rejects (PARSE_SYNTAX_ERROR)
modellingChoices.importer: skipped, counted per file as 'ALTER TABLE setting (storage, triggers, tags, masks, row security…)' in the ledger (notDesign)
modellingChoices.reason: Governance tags and column masks change no table, column, key or relationship.

loadErrors.reason: Access control: fakesnow has no GRANT; not schema.
DOCUMENT_SEARCH_INDEX, a CREATE TABLE … AS SELECT the truth does not count (see modellingChoices); DuckDB cannot bind its ARRAY lambda.
The script's BULK INSERTs of the sample data, which is not part of the sample (and CODEPAGE is Windows-only); the schema does not depend on it.
Full-text catalog and indexes: the Linux image has no full-text search; not tables or keys.

loadErrors.match: 7601: Cannot use a CONTAINS or FREETEXT
loadErrors.reason: A procedure using full-text search (as above).
